Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2412 of 2023
Applicant :- Ashok Kumar Tomar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramesh Chandra Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Ramesh Chandra Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B.Maurya, learned AGA-I, for the State.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 657 of 2020, under Sections 420,467,468,471, 120B, 504 and 506 IPC, Police Station Jagdishpura,
District Agra during pendency of the trial.

According to the FIR, co-accused persons executed a fake power of attorney in favour of applicant and one co-accused Trilok Chand and on the basis of Power of Attorney applicant and co-accused Trilok Chandra received Rs.Twenty Lacs on the basis of agreement to sale.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and applicant did not either prepare any fake Power of Attorney or he executed any sale deed and only allegation against the applicant is that on the basis of Power of Attorney which was executed in his favour by co-accused persons he executed agreement to sale and thereafter received Rs. Twenty Lacs.

He next submitted that informant of the case is not concerned with the present dispute and he is third party and he is having no concern with the dispute but in Ashok Kumar Tomar vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29551119/

He next submits that co-accused Trilok Chand in whose favour also Power of Attorney was executed has been released on anticipatory bail by this Court on 3.1.2023 passed in Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 10255 of 2022 and the order of accused Trilok Chand has been annexed as Annexure-22 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.

Criminal Misc.
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 10255 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submits that the co-accused Kishore @ Maharaj, who was one of the persons, who executed alleged Power of Attorney in favour of applicant, has already been released on bail vide order dated 24.1.2023 passed in Criminal Misc.Bail Application No.3323 of 2023, which has been annexed as Annexure-SA-1 to the Supplementary affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
He further submits that the present dispute is purely civil dispute and applicant in the present matter is in jail since 15.7.2022.

He next submits that although applicant is having criminal history of four other cases but he has explained criminal history of applicant in paragraph-22 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the FIR it appears that allegation against the applicant is that a fake Power of Attorney was executed in his favour along with co-accused Trilok Chand and on the basis of Power of Attorney co-accused Trilok Chand and applicant has executed an agreement to sale and received Rs.Twenty lacs.

Therefore, admittedly no sale deed was executed either by applicant or by co-accused Trilok Chand and co-accused Trilok Chand has already been released on bail on 3.1.2023 vide Criminal Misc.Anticipatory Bail Application No.10255 of 2022 and the co-accused Kishore @Maharaj, who executed Power of Attorney in favour of Trilok Chand and applicant has already been released on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court on 24.1.2023 vide Criminal Misc.Bail Application No. 3323j of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc.Anticipatory Bail Application No.10255 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Although applicant is having criminal history of four other cases but his criminal history has been explained in paragraph-2 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application.
Applicant in the present matter is in jail since 15.7.2022 and all the offences are triable by Magistrate First Class, therefore, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant-Ashok Kumar Tomar be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned Ashok Kumar Tomar vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29551119/

In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
